desc: Implement prefix DP solution: sort intervals by right endpoint, pred[i]=bisect_left(r_list, l_i) for strict r<l compatibility, exactly-k DP for k=0..4 storing (max_score, lex-smallest sorted index tuple), merge current original index into predecessor tuple, final scan over k=1..4 for global max score then lex-smallest tuple.

Execute the current solution on both provided examples (Example 1 → [2,3] score 8 PASS; Example 2 → [1,3,5,6] score 21 PASS) and randomized brute-force cross-check (n≤8, all size-≤4 non-overlapping subsets) — worker reported PASS with zero mismatches.

Validate the lexicographic tie-break mechanism against brute force on tie-heavy inputs (equal weights, duplicated intervals, boundary-touching r==l) — consistent with the proven insertion-monotonicity lemma.
Confirm complexity is acceptable for n=5·10^4: O(N log N) sort + predecessor, O(4·N) DP with ≤4-length tuple ops — no fallback approach needed.
